args.summary:
Built and analysed an 8×30 m precast, post-continuous T-girder bridge (2D spine beam, system "continuous"; no pier columns given so supports are bearings on rigid supports).

Key decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d; system: continuous (MR-05).
- Girder: T-girder, 5 per span, C50. Midspan single-girder section integrated: A=0.862 m², I=0.4450 m⁴; merged A=4.31 m², I=2.225 m⁴ (MR-02). Ec=34500 MPa (JTG 3362 3.1.5), γ=26 kN/m³ (JTG D60 4.2.1), w=112.06 kN/m, m=11.42 t/m (MR-07).
- Bearings: 5 per support line. Abutments 0/8 and piers 1/2/3/6/7 = PTFE sliding (longitudinally free, Kh=0); piers 4/5 = plain elastomeric fixed (longitudinal spring Kh=15000 kN/m). All lines: S=10.714, Kv=7.098e6 kN/m (JTG 3362 8.7, Ge=1.0 MPa).
- Live load: Class I, 3 lanes, ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320 kN per 30 m span (JTG D60 4.3.1).
- Impact factor: f1=4.52 Hz → μ=0.2509 (JTG D60 4.3.2).

Model ran cleanly; vertical frequencies [4.52, 4.70, 5.23] Hz, max lane positive moment 8356 kNm (span 1/8), max negative −6145 kNm.
